title: ChatGPT is getting a much-needed upgrade for managing your files - Digital Trends
summary: OpenAI introduces new file management features in ChatGPT, including a Recent files menu and a Library tab, to facilitate easier access and reuse of files across conversations. These features are available to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, and Business subscribers, with a global rollout excluding the EU, Switzerland, and UK for a short while.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive as these features aim to simplify file management and enhance productivity for users, reducing the tedium of handling files across multiple sessions.
